description: Gives annual traffic in one GB region (English regions, Scotland or Wales) by vehicle type, in million vehicle miles: cars and taxis, vans, HGVs, buses and coaches, motorcycles and pedal cycles, plus road length, newest year first. Useful for market sizing (for example van or HGV traffic for fleet services), journalism and coursework. Regional totals only; for a single council use local_authority_traffic_totals, and for one road use road_traffic_flow_at_point. (cost: 1 credit)

region_id.description: integer, required, DfT region id 1-11 (from traffic_regions_list, e.g. 7 East of England, 3 Scotland, 6 London)

year.description: integer, optional, a single year; default is the most recent years

years.description: integer, optional, how many recent years when year is not given, 1-40, default 10

name: region_traffic_by_vehicle_type
